title: mentha × villosa var. wirtgeniana
intro: Mentha × villosa var. wirtgeniana, commonly known as Hairy Mint, is a natural hybrid variety of the Mentha villosa plant species. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve nausea and headaches, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Hairy Mint include its antimicrobial, antiseptic, and anti-spasmodic properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Hairy Mint include menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and provide relief from various health conditions.
